verses.sloka: एवं विलपमानस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः।श्रुत्वा शोकाभितप्तस्य त्रिशिरा वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.६९.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: evaṁ vilapamānasya rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ।śrutvā śokābhitaptasya triśirā vākyamabravīt ।। 6.69.1 ।।

translations.english: Hearing the lamentations of the evilminded Ravana, Trisira spoke to him.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर अङ्गद के कहने से वे वानर लड़ने के es हो गए और पुनः पराक्रम का:आश्रय ले, अपने अपने बल ओर पराक्रम को बखान करने लगे

verses.sloka: एवमेव महावीर्यो हतो नस्तातमध्यमः।न तु सत्पुरुषा राजन् विलपन्ति यथा भवान् ।। ६.६९.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: evameva mahāvīryo hato nastātamadhyamaḥ।na tu satpuruṣā rājan vilapanti yathā bhavān ।। 6.69.2 ।।

translations.english: "There is no doubt that Kumbhakarna, who is your middle father and uncle, was also endowed with great prowess. He has been killed. O King! Good men like you do not wail."

verses.sloka: नूनं त्रिभुवनस्यापि पर्याप्तस्त्वमसि प्रभो।स कस्मात् प्राकृत इव शोचस्यात्मानमीदृशम् ।। ६.६९.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: nūnaṁ tribhuvanasyāpi paryāptastvamasi prabho।sa kasmāt prākṛta iva śocasyātmānamīdṛśam ।। 6.69.3 ।।

translations.english: "O King! You are a conqueror of the three worlds. Why do you wail like a common man?"
translations.hindi: वे सब वानर हथेली पर अपनी जानों को. रख, प्रसन्न बु हुए आगे बढ़े । वे अपने ब चने की आशा त्याग घोर युद्ध कर लगे

verses.sloka: ब्रह्मदत्ता ऽस्ति ते शक्तिः कवचः सायको धनुः।सहस्रखरसंयुक्तो रथो मेघस्वनो महान् ।। ६.६९.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: brahmadattā 'sti te śaktiḥ kavacaḥ sāyako dhanuḥ।sahasrakharasaṁyukto ratho meghasvano mahān ।। 6.69.4 ।।

translations.english: "You are bestowed by Brahma with a javelin, a shield and an arrow and a chariot yoked by a thousand donkeys making rumbling sounds like a cloud."
translations.hindi: वकक अथ इच्चान्‌ महाकायाः सानूनि सुमन le वानरास्तूणशुद्यम्य कुम्भकणममिद्ठता: है ४। एजः न्तमिः । (गे?) हा पो प्‌ बड़े बढ़े वक्ष और पर्वतशिखरों को बढी तेजी से उखाड़ तथा ले लेकर, कुम्मकर्ण की ओर दौड़े

verses.sloka: त्वया ऽसकृद्विशस्त्रेण विशस्ता देवदानवाः।स सर्वायुधसम्पन्नो राघवं शास्तुमर्हसि ।। ६.६९.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tvayā 'sakṛdviśastreṇa viśastā devadānavāḥ।sa sarvāyudhasampanno rāghavaṁ śāstumarhasi ।। 6.69.5 ।।

translations.english: "Devas and Danavas have been won over by you, deprived of weapons also. Now endowed with all weapons you will be able to win Raghava."

verses.sloka: कामं तिष्ठ महाराज निर्गमिष्याम्यहं रणम्।उद्धरिष्यामि ते शत्रून् गरुडः पन्नगानिव ।। ६.६९.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: kāmaṁ tiṣṭha mahārāja nirgamiṣyāmyahaṁ raṇam।uddhariṣyāmi te śatrūn garuḍaḥ pannagāniva ।। 6.69.6 ।।

translations.english: "O King! Stay on. I will move forth to the battlefield and uproot your enemy like Garuda uprooted serpents."
translations.hindi: शतानि सप्त चाशे च सहस्राणि च वानराः । प्रकीर्णाः शेरते भूमौ कुम्मकर्णेन रपोथिताः।। § ॥ कुम्भकर्णं की मार से एक एक बार में सात सात, आठ आठ सौ और हजार हजार वानरों के दल वेकाम हो धराशायी होने लगे

verses.sloka: शम्बरो देवराजेन नरको विष्णुना यथा।तथा ऽद्य शयिता रामो मया युधि निपातितः ।। ६.६९.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: śambaro devarājena narako viṣṇunā yathā।tathā 'dya śayitā rāmo mayā yudhi nipātitaḥ ।। 6.69.7 ।।

translations.english: "Just as Lord of Devas by Sambara, and Vishnu by Naraka, in the same way Rama will also be destroyed struck by me."

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा त्रिशिरसो वाक्यं रावणो राक्षसाधिपः।पुनर्जातमिवात्मानं मन्यते कालचोदितः ।। ६.६९.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: śrutvā triśiraso vākyaṁ rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ।punarjātamivātmānaṁ manyate kālacoditaḥ ।। 6.69.8 ।।

translations.english: Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, hearing Trisira's words thought that impelled by destiny that he was reborn.
translations.hindi: बह अत्यन्त कर द हो वानरों को बैसे ही खा रहा था, जैसे गरुड सांपों को खाते हैं । अब तो वानर बड़ी कठिनता से धैय धारण कर एकत्र हुए

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा त्रिशिरसो वाक्यं देवान्तकनरान्तकौ।अतिकायश्च तेजस्वी बभूवुर्युद्धहर्षिताः ।। ६.६९.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: śrutvā triśiraso vākyaṁ devāntakanarāntakau।atikāyaśca tejasvī babhūvuryuddhaharṣitāḥ ।। 6.69.9 ।।

translations.english: Hearing Trisira's words both Devanthaka and Naranthaka and glorious Atikaya became enthusiastic for combat.

verses.sloka: ततो ऽहमहमित्येव गर्जन्तो नैर्ऋतर्षभाः।रावणस्य सुता वीराः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमाः ।। ६.६९.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: tato 'hamahamityeva garjanto nairṛtarṣabhāḥ।rāvaṇasya sutā vīrāḥ śakratulyaparākramāḥ ।। 6.69.10 ।।

translations.english: Then Ravana's sons, the heroes, and bulls among ogres, equal to Indra in valour, roared saying, "I will start", "I will lead."

verses.sloka: अन्तरिक्षगताः सर्वे सर्वे मायाविशारदाः।सर्वे त्रिदशदर्पघ्नाः सर्वे च रणदुर्जयाः ।। ६.६९.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: antarikṣagatāḥ sarve sarve māyāviśāradāḥ।sarve tridaśadarpaghnāḥ sarve ca raṇadurjayāḥ ।। 6.69.11 ।।

translations.english: All (sons of Ravana) are capable of coursing through the sky, experts in conjuring tricks, capable of crushing the pride of Devatas and all, are fierce in fighting.

verses.sloka: सर्वे सुबलसम्पन्नाः सर्वे विकीर्णकीर्तयः।सर्वे समरमासाद्य न श्रूयन्ते पराजिताः।देवैरपि सगन्धर्वैः सकिन्नरमहोरगैः ।। ६.६९.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarve subalasampannāḥ sarve vikīrṇakīrtayaḥ।sarve samaramāsādya na śrūyante parājitāḥ।devairapi sagandharvaiḥ sakinnaramahoragaiḥ ।। 6.69.12 ।।

translations.english: All sons of Ravana possessed stupendous strength, all were very famous, and never got defeated in war be it Gandharvas, Kinnaras or even gods will get vanquished by them.

verses.sloka: सर्वे च विदुषो वीराः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः।सर्वे प्रवरविज्ञानाः सर्वे लब्धवरास्तथा ।। ६.६९.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarve ca viduṣo vīrāḥ sarve yuddhaviśāradāḥ।sarve pravaravijñānāḥ sarve labdhavarāstathā ।। 6.69.13 ।।

translations.english: All were experts in the use of weapons, all were heroes and skilled in warfare, knowledgeable in scriptures, so also all were blessed with boons.

verses.sloka: स तैस्तदा भास्करतुल्यवर्चसैः सुतैर्वृतः शत्रुबलप्रमर्दनैः।रराज राजा मघवान् यथा ऽमरैर्वृतो महादानवदर्पनाशनैः ।। ६.६९.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa taistadā bhāskaratulyavarcasaiḥ sutairvṛtaḥ śatrubalapramardanaiḥ।rarāja rājā maghavān yathā 'marairvṛto mahādānavadarpanāśanaiḥ ।। 6.69.14 ।।

translations.english: Surrounded by his sons, who matched Sun in brilliance and capable of crushing the pride of foes, great in destroying immortals, Ravana shone like Lord gods.
translations.hindi: कप योद्धा काल के समान वा ३ गई । रथ में सवार राक्षस योद्धा / ६ ४० युद्धकार छि शिरांसि नदतां जद्द ; सहसा भीम निःसबनः । वानराश्च सहात्मानः सुत्पाट्य महाद्रुमान्‌

verses.sloka: स पुत्रान् सम्परिष्वज्य भूषयित्वा च भूषणैः।आशीर्भिश्च प्रशस्ताभिः प्रेषयामास संयुगे ।। ६.६९.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa putrān sampariṣvajya bhūṣayitvā ca bhūṣaṇaiḥ।āśīrbhiśca praśastābhiḥ preṣayāmāsa saṁyuge ।। 6.69.15 ।।

translations.english: Ravana embraced his sons, decked them with ornaments and jewels and enriched them and offered benediction and sent to encounter.
translations.hindi: उनसे रथां, घोड़ों, हाथियों, ऊटों और राक्षसों का नाश करते थे । उवर हनुमान जी भी आकाश में स्थित हो कुम्भकणे के सिर के ऊपर बहुत से और विविध प्रकार के वृक्ष तथा पर्व तशिखर बर्‌सा रहे थे

verses.sloka: युद्धोन्मत्तं च मत्तं च भ्रातरौ चापि रावणः।रक्षणार्थं कुमाराणां प्रेषयामास संयुगे ।। ६.६९.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: yuddhonmattaṁ ca mattaṁ ca bhrātarau cāpi rāvaṇaḥ।rakṣaṇārthaṁ kumārāṇāṁ preṣayāmāsa saṁyuge ।। 6.69.16 ।।

translations.english: Ravana sent his two brothers Yuddhonmatta and Matta for the protection of his sons for defence in combat.
translations.hindi: कुम्मकण, हनुमान जी के फेंके हुए :पर्वेतशिखरो और. नक्षा को अपने शूज्ञ से चूर चूर कर डालता

verses.sloka: ते ऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं रावणं रिपुरावणम्।कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं चैव महाकायाः प्रतस्थिरे ।। ६.६९.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: te 'bhivādya mahātmānaṁ rāvaṇaṁ ripurāvaṇam।kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṁ caiva mahākāyāḥ pratasthire ।। 6.69.17 ।।

translations.english: Those heroes greeting gigantic Ravana, went around him clockwise (as per tradition) and departed.

verses.sloka: सर्वौषधीभिर्गन्धैश्च समालभ्य महाबलाः।निर्जग्मुर्नैर्ऋतश्रेष्ठाः षडेते युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः ।। ६.६९.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarvauṣadhībhirgandhaiśca samālabhya mahābalāḥ।nirjagmurnairṛtaśreṣṭhāḥ ṣaḍete yuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ।। 6.69.18 ।।

translations.english: The six leaders endowed with great strength, anointing themselves with fragrance, which can ward off injury went to fight.

verses.sloka: त्रिशिराश्चातिकायश्च देवान्तकनरान्तकौ।महोदरमहापार्श्वो निर्जग्मुः कालचोदिताः ।। ६.६९.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: triśirāścātikāyaśca devāntakanarāntakau।mahodaramahāpārśvo nirjagmuḥ kālacoditāḥ ।। 6.69.19 ।।

translations.english: Trisira, also Atikaya, Devanthaka, Naranthaka, Mahodara and Mahaparsva impelled by destiny went.
translations.hindi: $ र bn तानि चान्यानि रवास पुनश्रान्यदूगिरेः शिरः । तच्छेलशज्ञाभिहतं हता हतसारथि ॥ १२ हे हि तदनन्तर द्विविद ने एक दुसरा पर्वतशिखर 5 ल पर फेंका । उस शैलश्टङ्ग की चोट से रादसी सेना के कित रथ, सारथियों सहित नष्ट हो गए

verses.sloka: ततः सुदर्शनं नाम नीलजीमूतसन्निभम्।ऐरावतकुले जातमारुरोह महोदरः ।। ६.६९.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sudarśanaṁ nāma nīlajīmūtasannibham।airāvatakule jātamāruroha mahodaraḥ ।। 6.69.20 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Mahodara mounted on an elephant born of Airavata (Indra 's elephant) family, by name Sudarsana went.

verses.sloka: सर्वायुधसमायुक्तं तूणीभिश्च स्वलङ्कृतम्।रराज गजमास्थाय सवितेवास्तमूर्धनि ।। ६.६९.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarvāyudhasamāyuktaṁ tūṇībhiśca svalaṅkṛtam।rarāja gajamāsthāya savitevāstamūrdhani ।। 6.69.21 ।।

translations.english: Ready with all kinds of weapons, quivers as well mounted on elephants shone like the setting Sun in the west.
translations.hindi: हनुमान जी को अचानक व्यथित देख, राक्षस हर्षित हो हषेनाद करने लगे ओर वानर भय से दुःखी हो, समरभूमि सें कुम्भकर्ण के पासे भागने लगे

verses.sloka: हयोत्तमसमायुक्तं सर्वायुधसमाकुलम्।आरुरोह रथश्रेष्ठं त्रिशिरा रावणात्मजः ।। ६.६९.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: hayottamasamāyuktaṁ sarvāyudhasamākulam।āruroha rathaśreṣṭhaṁ triśirā rāvaṇātmajaḥ ।। 6.69.22 ।।

translations.english: Ravana's brother, Trisira went mounted on a chariot yoked to the best of horses with all kinds of weapons.

verses.sloka: त्रिशिरा रथमास्थाय विरराज धनुर्धरः।सविद्युदुल्कः शैलाग्रे सेन्द्रचाप इवाम्बुदः ।। ६.६९.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: triśirā rathamāsthāya virarāja dhanurdharaḥ।savidyudulkaḥ śailāgre sendracāpa ivāmbudaḥ ।। 6.69.23 ।।

translations.english: Wielding a bow and sitting like a leader in the chariot Trisira shone as if attended by lightning, meteors, light, and rainbows.
translations.hindi: उस पव तशिखर को अपने ऊरर आते देख, कु्मकण ने उसमें मूं क्रा मारा | वह पब तशिखर घू से के प्रहार से चूर चर हो गया

verses.sloka: त्रिभिः किरीटैः शुशुभे त्रिशिराः स रथोत्तमे।हिमवानिव शैलेन्द्रस्त्रिभिः काञ्चनपर्वतैः ।। ६.६९.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tribhiḥ kirīṭaiḥ śuśubhe triśirāḥ sa rathottame।himavāniva śailendrastribhiḥ kāñcanaparvataiḥ ।। 6.69.24 ।।

translations.english: Trisira seated in the best of chariots, with his three heads adorned with crowns shone like the golden mountain, Himalayas with its three peaks.
translations.hindi: उसमें से विनगारियाँ और ज्वाला निकलीं और बढ भूमि पर गिर गया । तदनन्तर ऋषभ, शरभ, नील, गवाक्ष, गन्धमादन गये

verses.sloka: अतिकायो ऽपि तेजस्वी राक्षसेन्द्रसुतस्तदा।आरुरोह रथश्रेष्ठं श्रेष्ठः सर्वधनुष्मताम् ।। ६.६९.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: atikāyo 'pi tejasvī rākṣasendrasutastadā।āruroha rathaśreṣṭhaṁ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadhanuṣmatām ।। 6.69.25 ।।

translations.english: Then Atikaya the very bright son of Rakshasa king, foremost of all archers mounted on the best of chariots.

verses.sloka: सुचक्राक्षं सुसंयुक्तं स्वनुकर्षं सुकूबरम्।तूणीबाणासनैर्दीप्तं प्रासासिपरिघाकुलम् ।। ६.६९.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sucakrākṣaṁ susaṁyuktaṁ svanukarṣaṁ sukūbaram।tūṇībāṇāsanairdīptaṁ prāsāsiparighākulam ।। 6.69.26 ।।

translations.english: The chariot (of Atikaya) had excellent wheels, well fitted with strong axles, stout poles, equipped with quivers and bows, with best of spears, bars, and swords.
translations.hindi: महाकाय कुम्भकण पर चारों आर से आक्रमण क्रिआ; किन्तु इन पाँचो के प्रहारो से उसे वैसा ही सुख हुप्रा जैसा कि, बदन दबाने से होता है। उसे उनके प्रहारों से तिल भर भी पीड़ा न हुईं

verses.sloka: स काञ्चनविचित्रेण मुकुटेन विराजता।भूषणैश्च बभौ मेरुः किरणैरिव भासयन् ।। ६.६९.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa kāñcanavicitreṇa mukuṭena virājatā।bhūṣaṇaiśca babhau meruḥ kiraṇairiva bhāsayan ।। 6.69.27 ।।

translations.english: His wonderful coronet encrusted with gold was shining, sparkling, and looked splendid like the Meru Mountain.
translations.hindi: कम्भकर्ण ने ऋषम को अपनी दोनों भुजाओं के बीच दाया । कुम्भकण द्वारा भुजाओ में दबाए जाने पर ऋषभ पीड़ित हुआ

verses.sloka: स रराज रथे तस्मिन् राजसूनुर्महाबलः।वृतो नैर्ऋतशार्दूलैर्वज्रपाणिरिवामरैः ।। ६.६९.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa rarāja rathe tasmin rājasūnurmahābalaḥ।vṛto nairṛtaśārdūlairvajrapāṇirivāmaraiḥ ।। 6.69.28 ।।

translations.english: The tiger among ogres (Atikaya) surrounded by the great army of ogres, the prince was shining in the chariot like Indra, the king of gods and wielder of thunderbolt.

verses.sloka: हयमुच्चैश्श्रवप्रख्यं श्वेतं कनकभूषणम्।मनोजवं महाकायमारुरोह नरान्तकः ।। ६.६९.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: hayamuccaiśśravaprakhyaṁ śvetaṁ kanakabhūṣaṇam।manojavaṁ mahākāyamāruroha narāntakaḥ ।। 6.69.29 ।।

translations.english: Naranthaka, mounted on Uchaisrava, the white horse, decked in gold, was swift as thought in speed.

verses.sloka: गृहीत्वा प्रासमुल्काभं विरराज नरान्तकः।शक्तिमादाय तेजस्वी गुहः शिखिगतो यथा ।। ६.६९.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: gṛhītvā prāsamulkābhaṁ virarāja narāntakaḥ।śaktimādāya tejasvī guhaḥ śikhigato yathā ।। 6.69.30 ।।

translations.english: Naranthaka seizing a barbed missile like a burning spear, looked like son of Lord Siva wielding javelin in hand.
translations.hindi: इन्द्रशत्र कुम्भकण ने थप्पड़ से गवाक्ष को मारा । फिर उसने बड़े जोर से लातों से गन्धमादन को मारा ॥ है १ स्पर्शानिव--सुखप्पर्शानिव । ( गो० ) ६५४ युद्धका!र दसप्रहारव्यथिता पुग्नुहु; शो शणितोलिता: निपेतुस्ते तु मेदिन्यां निळत्ता इव किशुकाः

verses.sloka: देवान्तकः समादाय परिघं वज्रभूषणम्।परिगृह्य गिरीं दोर्भ्यां वपुर्विष्णोर्विडम्बयन् ।। ६.६९.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: devāntakaḥ samādāya parighaṁ vajrabhūṣaṇam।parigṛhya girīṁ dorbhyāṁ vapurviṣṇorviḍambayan ।। 6.69.31 ।।

translations.english: Devanthaka, holding a bar encrusted with diamonds in both hands, seemed like Vishnu in disguise with a mountain (to churn the milky ocean).

verses.sloka: महापार्श्वो महाकायो गदामादाय वीर्यवान्।विरराज गदापाणिः कुबेर इव संयुगे ।। ६.६९.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: mahāpārśvo mahākāyo gadāmādāya vīryavān।virarāja gadāpāṇiḥ kubera iva saṁyuge ।। 6.69.32 ।।

translations.english: Mahaparsva holding an ace in hand in the war shone like Kubera.
translations.hindi: पर्वेताकार वानरश्रेष्ठ उछल उछल कर पर्वताकार शरीर वाले कुम्भके के;शरीर-पर चढ़, दाँतो से उसकी काटने लगे

verses.sloka: प्रतस्थिरे महात्मानो बलैरप्रतिमैर्वृताः।सुरा इवामरावत्या बलैरप्रतिमैर्वृताः ।। ६.६९.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: pratasthire mahātmāno balairapratimairvṛtāḥ।surā ivāmarāvatyā balairapratimairvṛtāḥ ।। 6.69.33 ।।

translations.english: Those great souls followed by elephants, horses, Rakshasas with superb weapons sounding like the rumbling of rainy clouds went like gods of Amaravati.
translations.hindi: बे वानरश्रेष्ठ बिशाल शरीरधारी कुम्भकर्ण को नखों से नोंचते ' थे, दांतों से काटते.थे तथा घूंसों.आर घुटनों से मारते थे

verses.sloka: तान् गजैश्च तुरङ्गैश्च रथैश्चाम्बुदनिस्वनैः।अनुजग्मुर्महात्मानो राक्षसाः प्रवरायुधाः ।। ६.६९.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tān gajaiśca turaṅgaiśca rathaiścāmbudanisvanaiḥ।anujagmurmahātmāno rākṣasāḥ pravarāyudhāḥ ।। 6.69.34 ।।

translations.english: The great princes were wearing crowns resplendent like the Sun and glowing like planets in the sky.
translations.hindi: उस समय पब ताकार राक्षसश्रेष्ठ कम्भकण असंख्य वानरो के लिपट जाने से उसी प्रकार शोभायमान होने लगा, जिस प्रकार वृक्षा से पवत शोभायमान होता है

verses.sloka: ते विरेजुर्महात्मानः कुमाराः सूर्यवर्चसः।किरीटिनः श्रिया जुष्टा ग्रहा दीप्ता इवाम्बरे ।। ६.६९.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: te virejurmahātmānaḥ kumārāḥ sūryavarcasaḥ।kirīṭinaḥ śriyā juṣṭā grahā dīptā ivāmbare ।। 6.69.35 ।।

translations.english: The princes, grasping the white weapons shone like flocks of white cranes in the dark autumnal clouds in the sky.
translations.hindi: अत्यन्त बलवान कुम्भ उन सब वानरों को भुजञाओं में पकडू कर, उसी प्रकार खाने लगा, जिस प्रकार क्रुद्ध हुए गरुङ जी साँपों को खाते हैं

verses.sloka: प्रगृहीता बभौ तेषां शस्त्राणामावलिः सिता।शारदाभ्रप्रतीकाशा हंसावलिरिवाम्बरे ।। ६.६९.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: pragṛhītā babhau teṣāṁ śastrāṇāmāvaliḥ sitā।śāradābhrapratīkāśā haṁsāvalirivāmbare ।। 6.69.36 ।।

translations.english: Those heroes determined to defeat the enemy even if it meant death and went thinking for the combat.
translations.hindi: पाताल की तरह कुम्भकर्णो के रुख में फेके जाने परे 'बानर कुम्भकर्णं के नथनों और कानो में हो कर निकल आते थे

verses.sloka: मरणं वापि निश्चित्य शत्रूणां वा पराजयम् ।। ६.६९.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: maraṇaṁ vāpi niścitya śatrūṇāṁ vā parājayam ।। 6.69.37 ।।

translations.english: The great Rakshasas who were fierce in combat went roaring shouting loudly and discharging arrows.
translations.hindi: वह पर्वैताकार राज्षसश्रेष्ठ अत्यन्त क्रुध हो वानरों को भक्षण करता हुआ, समस्त बानरी सेना को नष्ट करने लगा

verses.sloka: इति कृत्वा मतिं वीरा निर्जग्मुः संयुगार्थिनः ।। ६.६९.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: iti kṛtvā matiṁ vīrā nirjagmuḥ saṁyugārthinaḥ ।। 6.69.38 ।।

translations.english: By the sound of their clapping of arms and their lion roar it was as though the sky was breaking and the earth was shaking.

verses.sloka: जगर्जुश्च प्रणेदुश्च चिक्षिपुश्चापि सायकान्।जगृहुश्चापि ते वीरा निर्यान्तो युद्धदुर्मदाः ।। ६.६९.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: jagarjuśca praṇeduśca cikṣipuścāpi sāyakān।jagṛhuścāpi te vīrā niryānto yuddhadurmadāḥ ।। 6.69.39 ।।

translations.english: Departing from there the Rakshasa army saw Vanara army ready with many rocks.

verses.sloka: क्ष्वेलितास्फोटनिनदैश्चचाल च वसुन्धरा।रक्षसां सिंहनादैश्च पुस्फोटेव तदा ऽम्बरम् ।। ६.६९.४० ।।
verses.transliteration: kṣvelitāsphoṭaninadaiścacāla ca vasundharā।rakṣasāṁ siṁhanādaiśca pusphoṭeva tadā 'mbaram ।। 6.69.40 ।।

translations.english: The huge monkeys also saw groups of elephants, horses and chariots and heard hundreds of bells of the chariots and Rakshasas all over like groups of dark clouds with huge weapons glowing like fire and Sun surrounded by Rakshasa army.
translations.hindi: जब कम्प्रकर्ण ने वानरों के अनेक यूथपतियों को सार्‌ डाला तब बिना नायक के कुम्भकर्ण द्वारा मारे जाते हुए, वे सब बानर भयभीत हो बड़ जोर से चिल्लाने लगे

verses.sloka: ते ऽभिनिष्क्रम्य मुदिता राक्षसेन्द्रा महाबलाः।ददृशुर्वानरानीकं समुद्यतशिलानगम् ।। ६.६९.४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: te 'bhiniṣkramya muditā rākṣasendrā mahābalāḥ।dadṛśurvānarānīkaṁ samudyataśilānagam ।। 6.69.41 ।।

translations.english: The huge monkeys also saw groups of elephants, horses and chariots and heard hundreds of bells of the chariots and Rakshasas all over like groups of dark clouds with huge weapons glowing like fire and Sun surrounded by Rakshasa army.

verses.sloka: हरयो ऽपि महात्मानो ददृशुर्नैर्ऋतं बलम्।हस्त्यश्वरथसम्बाधं किङ्किणीशतनादितम् ।। ६.६९.४२ ।।
verses.transliteration: harayo 'pi mahātmāno dadṛśurnairṛtaṁ balam।hastyaśvarathasambādhaṁ kiṅkiṇīśatanāditam ।। 6.69.42 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the Rakshasa army approaching, the monkeys found an opportunity to attack them and collected huge mountains, deadly strong trees in great joy unable to tolerate roared in return.
translations.hindi: कम्भकण ने जब बहुत से वानर मार डाले, तब बचे हुए ' वानर व्यथित और खन्नमन हो श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के पास जा उनकी दुहाई देने लगे

verses.sloka: नीलजीमूतसङ्काशं समुद्यतमहायुधम्।दीप्तानलपविप्रख्यैः सर्वतो नैर्ऋतैर्वृतम् ।। ६.६९.४३ ।।
verses.transliteration: nīlajīmūtasaṅkāśaṁ samudyatamahāyudham।dīptānalapaviprakhyaiḥ sarvato nairṛtairvṛtam ।। 6.69.43 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the Rakshasa army approaching, the monkeys found an opportunity to attack them and collected huge mountains, deadly strong trees in great joy unable to tolerate roared in return.

verses.sloka: तद् दृष्ट्वा बलमायान्तं लब्धलक्षाः प्लवङ्गमाः।समुद्यतमहाशैलाः सम्प्रणेदुर्महाबलाः।अमृष्यमाणा रक्षांसि प्रतिनर्दन्ति वानराः ।। ६.६९.४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tad dṛṣṭvā balamāyāntaṁ labdhalakṣāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ।samudyatamahāśailāḥ sampraṇedurmahābalāḥ।amṛṣyamāṇā rakṣāṁsi pratinardanti vānarāḥ ।। 6.69.44 ।।

translations.english: There upon the Vanara leaders, endowed with extraordinary prowess, beholding the joy of Rakshasa troops, unable to bear roared dreadfully.
translations.hindi: ्् 5 १ बिनायकाः= विगतनायकाः | ( गो० ) / जप उ, एलन = प € क उनके हाथ में एक पर्वेतशिखर था ओर बे वार बार सिंह- नाद कर, कुम्भकण के साथ आई हुई राक्षसों की समस्त पैदल सेना को त्रस्त कर रहे थे

verses.sloka: ततः समुद्घुष्टरवं निशम्य रक्षोगणा वानरयूथपानाम्।अमृष्यमाणाः परहर्षमुग्रं महाबला भीमतरं विनेदुः ।। ६.६९.४५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ samudghuṣṭaravaṁ niśamya rakṣogaṇā vānarayūthapānām।amṛṣyamāṇāḥ paraharṣamugraṁ mahābalā bhīmataraṁ vineduḥ ।। 6.69.45 ।।

translations.english: Those monkey leaders entering dreadful Rakshasa army uplifted rocks and mountains with trees and shone.

verses.sloka: ते राक्षसबलं घोरं प्रविश्य हरियूथपाः।विचेरुरुद्यतैः शैलैर्नगाः शिखरिणो यथा ।। ६.६९.४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: te rākṣasabalaṁ ghoraṁ praviśya hariyūthapāḥ।vicerurudyataiḥ śailairnagāḥ śikhariṇo yathā ।। 6.69.46 ।।

translations.english: Some monkeys springing into the sky, while some staying on earth, with trees, rocks as weapons, enraged, ranged the Rakshasa army.
translations.hindi: और उछल कर एक लात कस्भकण की छाती में जसायी । डस लात क आघाते स्त बहु पचताकार शरीर वाला कम्भकणा मूर्छित हो गया

verses.sloka: केचिदाकाशमाविश्य केचिदुर्व्यां प्लवङ्गमाः।रक्षस्सैन्येषु सङ्क्रुद्धाश्चेरुर्द्रुमशिलायुधाः ।। ६.६९.४७ ।।
verses.transliteration: kecidākāśamāviśya kecidurvyāṁ plavaṅgamāḥ।rakṣassainyeṣu saṅkruddhāścerurdrumaśilāyudhāḥ ।। 6.69.47 ।।

translations.english: Vanara leaders seizing huge branches of trees fought a frightening war with Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: द्रुमांश्च विपुलस्कन्धान् गृह्य वानरपुङ्गवाः।तद्युद्धमभवद् घोरं रक्षोवानरसङ्कुलम् ।। ६.६९.४८ ।।
verses.transliteration: drumāṁśca vipulaskandhān gṛhya vānarapuṅgavāḥ।tadyuddhamabhavad ghoraṁ rakṣovānarasaṅkulam ।। 6.69.48 ।।

translations.english: The Vanaras of dreadful valour and unparalleled might waged with trees, rock and mountain when obstructed by the Rakshasas।।
translations.hindi: दे अपने को अपने आप छुडा लेंगे । 0000 च i भे कम्भ ऋण के प्रहार से वे बहुत ऐसा जान पड़ता है कि, युद्ध में कुम्मफल है | रोटिल हो कर, मित हो गए है

verses.sloka: ते पादपशिलाशैलैश्चक्रुर्वृष्टिमनूपमाम्।बाणौघैर्वायमाणाश्च हरयो भीमविक्रमाः ।। ६.६९.४९ ।।
verses.transliteration: te pādapaśilāśailaiścakrurvṛṣṭimanūpamām।bāṇaughairvāyamāṇāśca harayo bhīmavikramāḥ ।। 6.69.49 ।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas and Vanaras enthusiastic in the battlefield roared like lion. The Vanaras pounded the Rakshasas with rocks.

verses.sloka: सिंहनादान् विनेदुश्च रणे वानरराक्षसाः।शिलाभिश्चूर्णयामासुर्यातुधानान् प्लवङ्गमाः ।। ६.६९.५० ।।
verses.transliteration: siṁhanādān vineduśca raṇe vānararākṣasāḥ।śilābhiścūrṇayāmāsuryātudhānān plavaṅgamāḥ ।। 6.69.50 ।।

translations.english: In the combat, the enraged Vanaras killed Rakshasas decked with shields and ornaments. Some killed the ones mounted on chariots, elephants, and horses.
translations.hindi: यदि में उन मद्दाबलवान सुध्रीब को छुड़ा लूँगा, तो यह बात इनको केवल बुरी ही न लगेगो, किन्तु इससे उनको बड़ा कष्ट होगा और उनकी कीर्ति भी सदा के लिए नष्ट हो जायगी

verses.sloka: निजघ्नुः संयुगे क्रुद्धाः कवचाभरणावृतान्।केचिद्रथगतान् वीरान् गजवाजिगतानपि ।। ६.६९.५१ ।।
verses.transliteration: nijaghnuḥ saṁyuge kruddhāḥ kavacābharaṇāvṛtān।kecidrathagatān vīrān gajavājigatānapi ।। 6.69.51 ।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas also pierced with arrows the foremost of the monkeys and struck with tridents swords and lances.

verses.sloka: चेरुः पेतुश्च नेदुश्च तत्र राक्षसपुङ्गवाः।राक्षसाश्च शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्बिभिदुः कपिकुञ्जरान् ।। ६.६९.५३ ।।

translations.english: Their limbs stained with the blood of foes, both Vanaras and Rakshasas eager to conquer one another started striking one another.

verses.transliteration: śūlamudgarakhaḍgaiśca jaghnuḥ prāsaiśca śaktibhiḥ।anyonyaṁ pātayāmāsuḥ parasparajayaiṣiṇaḥ ।। 6.69.54 ।।

translations.english: Then in a short while the battlefield was covered with blood and rocks and swords used by the monkeys and Rakshasas.

translations.english: The monkeys struck at the Rakshasas taking the weapons left over and tearing the weapons of the Rakshasas and the Vanaras also struck the Rakshasas.

verses.transliteration: ākṣipya ca śilāsteṣāṁ nijaghnū rākṣasā harīn।teṣāṁ cācchidya śastrāṇi jaghnū rakṣāṁsi vānarāḥ ।। 6.69.59 ।।

translations.english: In the battlefield both Vanaras and Rakshasas struck at one another with their head, rocks and swords and emitted lion roar.

verses.sloka: निजघ्नुः शैलशूलास्त्रैर्बिभिदुश्च परस्परम्।सिंहनादान् विनेदुश्च रणे वानरराक्षसाः ।। ६.६९.६० ।।
verses.transliteration: nijaghnuḥ śailaśūlāstrairbibhiduśca parasparam।siṁhanādān vineduśca raṇe vānararākṣasāḥ ।। 6.69.60 ।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas killed by Vanaras, their shields and weapons broken, blood flowed from their limbs just as sap exudes from broken trees.

verses.sloka: छिन्नवर्मतनुत्राणा राक्षसा वानरैर्हताः।रुधिरं प्रस्रुतास्तत्र रससारमिव द्रुमाः ।। ६.६९.६१ ।।
verses.transliteration: chinnavarmatanutrāṇā rākṣasā vānarairhatāḥ।rudhiraṁ prasrutāstatra rasasāramiva drumāḥ ।। 6.69.61 ।।

translations.english: In the battlefield a chariot with another chariot, an elephant with another elephant, a horse with another horse struck one another.

verses.transliteration: rathena ca rathaṁ cāpi vāraṇenaiva vāraṇam ।। 6.69.62 ।।

translations.english: Rakshasas shattered the Vanara leaders with horseshoe shaped, halfmoon shaped, spear shaped sharp arrows, as well as trees and rocks.

translations.english: The battlefield, covered with broken trees and mountains, fallen vanaras and rakshasas, seemed difficult to tread on ground.

translations.english: Mighty Naranthaka, the destroyer of humans, ranged over all sides in all directions in the battlefield, like the wind in the rainy season, taking a burning spear and crushing everything.

verses.transliteration: yāvadutpāṭayāmāsurvṛkṣān śailān vanaukasaḥ।tāvat prāsahatāḥ peturvajrakṛttā ivācalāḥ ।। 6.69.75 ।।

translations.english: With lance that looked like death and the spear glowing like the Sun, Naranthaka routed the Vanaras, who fell down.

verses.transliteration: ekenāntakakalpena prāsenādityatejasā।bhinnāni harisainyāni nipeturdharaṇītale ।। 6.69.78 ।।

translations.english: The Vanaras who were struck by Kumbhakarna and fallen unconscious, came and stood before Sugriva.

verses.sloka: वज्रनिष्पेषसदृशं प्रासस्याभिनिपातनम्।न शेकुर्वानराः सोढुं ते विनेदुर्महास्वनम् ।। ६.६९.७९ ।।

translations.english: Sugriva looked around all over the monkey troops running here and there out of fear of Naranthaka.

verses.sloka: पततां हरिवीराणां रूपाणि प्रचकाशिरे।वज्रभिन्नाग्रकूटानां शैलानां पततामिव ।। ६.६९.८० ।।
verses.transliteration: patatāṁ harivīrāṇāṁ rūpāṇi pracakāśire।vajrabhinnāgrakūṭānāṁ śailānāṁ patatāmiva ।। 6.69.80 ।।

translations.english: (Sugriva) saw the Vanaras troops running and Naranthaka seated on horseback advancing with a spear.
translations.hindi: सो कुछ देर बाद जब वे'सचेत हो जाँयगे, तब वे अपनी तथा बानरों की भलाई के लिये जो उचित सममेंगे बह स्थयं करेंगे ॥ ७: ॥। मया तु मोच्षितस्यास्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः । ्रप्रीतिश्च भवेत्कष्टा कीर्तिनाशश्च शाश्‍वत!

verses.sloka: ये तु पूर्वं महात्मानः कुम्भकर्णेन पातिताः।ते स्वस्था वानरश्रेष्ठाः सुग्रीवमुपतस्थिरे ।। ६.६९.८१ ।।
verses.transliteration: ye tu pūrvaṁ mahātmānaḥ kumbhakarṇena pātitāḥ।te svasthā vānaraśreṣṭhāḥ sugrīvamupatasthire ।। 6.69.81 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva, the Lord of Vanaras seeing (Naranthaka advancing) spoke to his son Angada who resembled Indra in valour.

verses.sloka: विप्रेक्षमाणः सुग्रीवो ददर्श हरिवाहिनीम्।नरान्तकभयत्रस्तां विद्रवन्तीमितस्ततः ।। ६.६९.८२ ।।
verses.transliteration: viprekṣamāṇaḥ sugrīvo dadarśa harivāhinīm।narāntakabhayatrastāṁ vidravantīmitastataḥ ।। 6.69.82 ।।

translations.english: "Oh! March ahead and immediately release the life of the Rakshasa seated on horseback terrifying the Vanara army."

verses.sloka: विद्रुतां वाहिनीं दृष्ट्वा स ददर्श नरान्तकम्।गृहीतप्रासमायान्तं हयपृष्ठे प्रतिष्ठितम् ।। ६.६९.८३ ।।

verses.sloka: निरायुधो महातेजाः केवलं नखदंष्ट्रवान्।नरान्तकमभिक्रम्य वालिपुत्रो ऽब्रवीद्वचः ।। ६.६९.८८ ।।
verses.transliteration: nirāyudho mahātejāḥ kevalaṁ nakhadaṁṣṭravān।narāntakamabhikramya vāliputro 'bravīdvacaḥ ।। 6.69.88 ।।

translations.english: Hearing Angada's words Naranthaka flew into a rage. Biting his lips with teeth, hissing like a serpent Naranthaka stood before Angada. He hurled his spear glowing like fire on Angada's chest violently. It struck Angada and shattered, went round, and fell.
translations.hindi: उस समय नाझ और कानों के कट जाने से, नखों तथा दाँतों से विदीणे होने के कारण पीड़ित होमे से, तथा सारा अंग रका से तर हो जाने से, झुम्भकणं ने अत्यन्त क्रोध में भर, सुप्रीब को ` घुमा कर भूमि पर पटक दिआ और उदको रगड़ दिया

verses.transliteration: tiṣṭha kiṁ prākṛtairebhirharibhistvaṁ kariṣyasi।asmin vajrasamasparśaṁ prāsaṅkṣipa mamorasi ।। 6.69.89 ।।

translations.english: Then Vali's son beholding the broken and shattered spear fallen like the coils of serpent, raised his palm and struck at the head of Naranthaka's horse.

verses.sloka: अङ्गदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रचुक्रोध नरान्तकः।सन्दश्य दशनैरोष्ठं विनिश्वस्य भुजङ्गवत् ।। ६.६९.९० ।।
verses.transliteration: aṅgadasya vacaḥ śrutvā pracukrodha narāntakaḥ।sandaśya daśanairoṣṭhaṁ viniśvasya bhujaṅgavat ।। 6.69.90 ।।

translations.english: His horse, which closely resembled a mountain, fell on the ground, its head broken, cheeks drawn in, eyeballs broken, tongue got ejected by the stroke of the palm of Angada.

verses.sloka: अभिगम्याङ्गदं क्रुद्धो वालिपुत्रं नरान्तकः ।। ६.६९.९१ ।।
verses.transliteration: abhigamyāṅgadaṁ kruddho vāliputraṁ narāntakaḥ ।। 6.69.91 ।।

translations.english: Observing the horse fallen, Naranthaka, endowed with great power, overcome by anger raised his fist and struck at the head of Vali's son.

verses.sloka: प्रासं समाविध्य तदा ऽङ्गदाय समुज्ज्वलन्तं सहसोत्ससर्ज।स वालिपुत्रोरसि वज्रकल्पे बभूव भग्नो न्यपतच्च भूमौ ।। ६.६९.९२ ।।
verses.transliteration: prāsaṁ samāvidhya tadā 'ṅgadāya samujjvalantaṁ sahasotsasarja।sa vāliputrorasi vajrakalpe babhūva bhagno nyapatacca bhūmau ।। 6.69.92 ।।

translations.english: Angada's head smashed by the blow of the fist of Naranthaka, hot blood flowed rapidly for a while. Recovering from delusion, gaining consciousness he wondered at the strength of Naranthaka.

verses.sloka: तं प्रासमालोक्य तदा विभग्नं सुपर्णकृत्तोरगभोगकल्पम्।तलं समुद्यम्य स वालिपुत्रस्तुरङ्गमं तस्य जघान मूर्ध्नि ।। ६.६९.९३ ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ prāsamālokya tadā vibhagnaṁ suparṇakṛttoragabhogakalpam।talaṁ samudyamya sa vāliputrasturaṅgamaṁ tasya jaghāna mūrdhni ।। 6.69.93 ।।

translations.english: Angada clenching his fist, whose vehemence was equal to vehemence of death coming down from the top of the mountain peak, brought down Naranthaka.

verses.sloka: निमग्नतालुः स्फुटिताक्षितारो निष्क्रान्तजिह्वो ऽचलसन्निकाशः।स तस्य वाजी निपपात भूमौ तलप्रहारेण विशीर्णमूर्धा ।। ६.६९.९४ ।।
verses.transliteration: nimagnatāluḥ sphuṭitākṣitāro niṣkrāntajihvo 'calasannikāśaḥ।sa tasya vājī nipapāta bhūmau talaprahāreṇa viśīrṇamūrdhā ।। 6.69.94 ।।

translations.english: Naranthaka's chest having been split by a blow on his chest, vomiting flaming blood from his throat was as if shattered by the stroke of lightning fell down like a mountain.

verses.sloka: नरान्तकः क्रोधवशं जगाम हतं तुरङ्गं पतितं निरीक्ष्य।स मुष्टिमुद्यम्य महाप्रभावो जघान शीर्षे युधि वालिपुत्रम् ।। ६.६९.९५ ।।
verses.transliteration: narāntakaḥ krodhavaśaṁ jagāma hataṁ turaṅgaṁ patitaṁ nirīkṣya।sa muṣṭimudyamya mahāprabhāvo jaghāna śīrṣe yudhi vāliputram ।। 6.69.95 ।।

translations.english: Naranthaka, the foremost of the heroes, having been killed in combat, the Devatas and gods of the three worlds experienced great joy.

verses.sloka: अथाङ्गदो मुष्टिविभिन्नमूर्धा सुस्राव तीव्रं रुधिरं भृशोष्णम्।मुहुर्विजज्वाल मुमोह चापि सञ्ज्ञां समासाद्य विसिष्मिये च ।। ६.६९.९६ ।।
verses.transliteration: athāṅgado muṣṭivibhinnamūrdhā susrāva tīvraṁ rudhiraṁ bhṛśoṣṇam।muhurvijajvāla mumoha cāpi sañjñāṁ samāsādya visiṣmiye ca ।। 6.69.96 ।।

translations.english: Then Angada performed that feat of valour, most hard to do and gladdening the heart of Rama; and he of dreadful deeds marvelled, and again was gladdened in the battle.

verses.sloka: अथाङ्गदो वज्रसमानवेगं संवर्त्य मुष्टिं गिरिशृङ्गकल्पम्।निपातयामास तदा महात्मा नरान्तकस्योरसि वालिपुत्रः ।। ६.६९.९७ ।।
verses.transliteration: athāṅgado vajrasamānavegaṁ saṁvartya muṣṭiṁ giriśṛṅgakalpam।nipātayāmāsa tadā mahātmā narāntakasyorasi vāliputraḥ ।। 6.69.97 ।।

verses.sloka: स मुष्टिनिष्पष्टविभिन्नवक्षा ज्वालावमच्छोणितदिग्धगात्रः।नरान्तको भूमितले पपात यथा ऽचलो वज्रनिपातभग्नः ।। ६.६९.९८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa muṣṭiniṣpaṣṭavibhinnavakṣā jvālāvamacchoṇitadigdhagātraḥ।narāntako bhūmitale papāta yathā 'calo vajranipātabhagnaḥ ।। 6.69.98 ।।

verses.sloka: अथान्तरिक्षे त्रिदशोत्तमानां वनौकसां चैव महाप्रणादः।बभूव तस्मिन्निहते ऽग्र्यवीरे नरान्तके वालिसुतेन सङ्ख्ये ।। ६.६९.९९ ।।
verses.transliteration: athāntarikṣe tridaśottamānāṁ vanaukasāṁ caiva mahāpraṇādaḥ।babhūva tasminnihate 'gryavīre narāntake vālisutena saṅkhye ।। 6.69.99 ।।

verses.sloka: अथाङ्गदो राममनःप्रहर्षणं सुदुष्करं तत् कृतवान् हि विक्रमम्।विसिष्मिये सो ऽप्यतिवीर्यविक्रमः पुनश्च युद्धे स बभूव हर्षितः ।। ६.६९.१०० ।।
verses.transliteration: athāṅgado rāmamanaḥpraharṣaṇaṁ suduṣkaraṁ tat kṛtavān hi vikramam।visiṣmiye so 'pyativīryavikramaḥ punaśca yuddhe sa babhūva harṣitaḥ ।। 6.69.100 ।।

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे एकोनसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। ६९ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe ekonasaptatitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 69 ।।

translations.hindi: ॥ बह चर्बी और रुधिर से नहा उठा है । उसके कानों पर अँत- ड्याँ लटक रही हैं । तो भी तीइश ढाँती बाला कुम्भकण वानरा को शूल की मार से उसी तरह नाश कर रहा है, जि तरह युग के अन्त में प्रलय का समय उपस्थित हो ने पर, प्रज्बलित अथवा बढ़ा हुआ अर्ति प्रजा का नाश करता है
